opportunities.title: Authors' Contingency Fund

amount.raw: Grants range in value and are designed to meet immediate need

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all professional authors (fiction writers, illustrators, literary translators, scriptwriters, poets, journalists and others) resident in the UK or British citizens, for whom author-related activities make up a substantial amount of their annual income. Not open to editors, copywriters or salaried journalists. Membership of the SoA not required. Previous grant recipients must wait four full calendar years before reapplying.
opportunities.summary: Small, short-term hardship grants to authors in financial difficulty, to help them return to their normal working practice (e.g. lost income, project shortfalls, illness, one-off expenses).

opportunities.title: Authors' Foundation
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to writers who have been previously published or have a contract for their project with a commercial UK or Irish publisher. Accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects. Hybrid and self-published books not eligible. Previous recipients must wait four years before re-applying.
opportunities.summary: Grants to help develop a work-in-progress (research, travel or general expenditure). All applicants are automatically considered for specific named awards (Eric Ambler, Taner Baybars, John Brooks, Antonia Fraser, Arthur Welton, Great Britain Sasakawa grants).

opportunities.title: K Blundell Trust
opportunities.eligibility_summary: British authors under the age of 40, resident in the United Kingdom, who have previously had a work of which they are the sole author published with a commercial UK publisher. Hybrid and self-published books not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Work-in-progress grants for British authors under 40 whose work aims to increase social awareness. Accepts fiction, non-fiction, poetry and script projects.

opportunities.title: Society of Authors' Access Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (anyone who creates work for publication, broadcast or performance) who meet SoA membership criteria. Open to UK and Irish residents and British and Irish citizens. Membership not required. One grant per calendar year.
opportunities.summary: Grants for travel, subsistence, childcare or access needs for events, residencies and retreats.

opportunities.title: Strachey Trust Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to all authors (as defined by SoA Full Membership criteria, though membership not required) who are UK resident or British citizens, working on a specific full-length literary project with a strong likelihood of publication. One application per calendar year; successful applicants must wait four years before re-applying.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable authors to travel to a UK or Republic of Ireland archive or collection to research unpublished manuscript material for a specific full-length literary project.
